project_info.theme: Glamorous red-carpet portrait in a black lattice-detail gown
project_info.color_palette: black, nude-beige, honey blonde, hot pink backdrop and crisp event flash

main_subject.detail: Clearly adult woman with long voluminous honey-blonde Hollywood waves and a middle part, pale blue-green eyes, luminous makeup, peach-pink blush and glossy rose lips. She stands in a red-carpet pose with hands resting naturally at her hips, wearing a floor-length strapless column gown with a sweetheart neckline, a nude-beige lined base and intricate black sequined lattice detailing.
main_subject.style: photorealistic premium red-carpet event photography with crisp sequin texture

composition_elements.layout: vertical medium portrait with subject centered in front of a black-and-pink premiere wall
composition_elements.background: dark event backdrop with hot-pink graphic panels and blurred neutral event text
composition_elements.text: Keep background text blurred and non-identifying; no recognizable celebrity branding.

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: direct professional event flash with crisp front illumination
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: luminous hair and skin, high-detail sequins and polished red-carpet energy

technical_specs.optics: portrait lens, medium crop, sharp subject and gown detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic red-carpet portrait of a generic clearly adult woman with long voluminous honey-blonde hair styled in soft classic Hollywood waves with a middle part, pale blue-green eyes, luminous skin, peach-pink blush, glossy rose-pink lips and elegant event makeup. She stands confidently with hands resting naturally at her hips, wearing a custom floor-length strapless column gown with a sweetheart neckline, a nude-beige lined base and intricate black sequined lattice detailing across the bodice and skirt. Set her before a dark premiere backdrop with hot-pink graphic panels and blurred non-identifying event text. Use professional event flash, crisp fabric and sequin detail, natural skin texture and polished red-carpet photography. Preserve the source gown, hair, pose, backdrop palette and event-flash concept without reproducing Sydney Sweeney or any public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, transparent gown, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, readable event logo, distorted text
